sources.title: Life in the United Kingdom: A Guide for New Residents
sources.publisher: Home Office (sold through the official Life in the UK Test shop)
sources.notes: The only text the test is based on. It is sold as a book, an eBook and in audio; no free official copy is published, so there is no downloaded copy. It was not bought and not read: its edition, contents and licence terms are not recorded here, and no question in this pack is taken from it.

not_found.searched: No list of test questions is published. The Life in the UK Test guide on GOV.UK says only that the 24 questions are based on the Life in the UK handbook.
The GOV.UK guide mentions an e-learning subscription and an official practice app, both from the official shop. No free official practice test is published on GOV.UK.
The test is taken on a computer at a test centre; the GOV.UK guide describes no interview and lists no interview questions.
